turns.style: You are voicing AGENT CROWE, a tall grim government agent in an animated comedy short. Deep, gravelly, slow American voice. At night in a closed superstore he speaks into the customer-service microphone, and his voice booms through the empty aisles; he holds up a pink plush toy to the security camera. Calm, slow, menacing politeness, like a store announcement from a nightmare. After a long pause, the last word is alone and different: he has just heard a name crackle from his detector, and he says it slowly, quietly, savouring it, a dark smile in the voice.
turns.text: Attention, shoppers. <short pause> Have you seen... this? <long pause> ...Peek.
